summary: RapidRAW 1.7 adds Furka, a new rendering engine that demosaics RAW files on the GPU and rebuilds the tone sliders for cleaner detail and stronger highlight and shadow recovery, plus RapidRes, a 2x AI upscaler. Existing edits will look different, color grading most of all. The filmstrip can now dock into a side panel, and each camera can get its own default preset.
